title: Evidence: per-party exportable trail
summary: evidence.js export --party --from --to writes a folder and a zip of the party's events, commitment histories, verify results, external-gate rows, provenance and ledger rows, with a sha256 manifest; evidence.js check re-hashes a folder.

tools.purpose: export a per-party trail (events, commitments, verify, gate rows, provenance, ledger) with a digest manifest

limits.why: the module's own caps; shipped closed, opened only by the owner
